name: Jean-Marc Germain - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Belgium – EGF/2025/004 BE/Tupperware
part_text:
The European Parliament approves giving Belgium 1,622,650 euros from a European Union fund that helps workers who lose their jobs. The money covers 85 percent of a 1,909,000 euro support plan for 267 former Tupperware workers in Aalst, whose factory went bankrupt in February 2025. The plan offers job-search help, career guidance, training, digital skills courses and a job fair. Parliament also asks Belgium to report clearly on how the money was spent and what results it achieved.

- Belgium receives 1,622,650 euros to help 267 former Tupperware workers in Aalst find new jobs.
- The workers get guidance, training, digital skills help and job-search support.
- Belgium must show how the money was used and what results it delivered.
